name: @nu-sync/temporal-protobuf-es
description: Community-maintained Temporal TypeScript payload converters for protobuf-es messages.

scripts.check:generated-fixtures: npm run generate:fixtures && git diff --exit-code -- test/e2e/generated-schema/orders_pb.d.ts test/e2e/generated-schema/orders_pb.js
scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }) + '\n')"
scripts.format: prettier --check package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json tsconfig.cjs.json buf.gen.yaml README.md "scripts/**/*.mjs" "src/**/*.ts" "test/**/*.cjs" "test/**/*.mjs"
scripts.release-check: npm run verify && npm run format && npm run pack
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit:run && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.test:e2e:run: node --test test/e2e/npm-packed-fixture.test.mjs && node --test test/e2e/sdk-loader-fixture.test.mjs && node --test test/e2e/generated-schema-fixture.test.mjs && node --test test/e2e/deno-packed-fixture.test.mjs && node --test test/e2e/rust-wire-format.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run test:unit:run
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.verify:integration: npm run release-check && npm run test:e2e:temporal-worker
